_comment: Static fallback blog data for the GitHub Pages and Vercel builds, which cannot reach the live Cloudflare D1 database at build time. Mirrors migrations/0001_init.sql at the moment of migration. Regenerate from the admin panel's Dashboard -> "Export Snapshot" action (see ADMIN.md) after publishing changes, then commit this file and redeploy those two targets to bring them back in sync. The Cloudflare deployment never reads this file - it queries D1 directly and always reflects the latest published posts immediately.
